title: Pocketwire Advance Late Fee Relief Amount — Calculation Note
content:
The payroll-delay relief on a Pocketwire Advance line acts on the late fee most recently booked on the line. The relief share is 10 percent (0.10) of that late fee. The relief is that late fee multiplied by the relief share, rounded to the cent (half up), and never more than the late fee itself.

## Terms

- **The late fee** — the late fee entry with the latest booking date on the line's activity. Its amount is the base of the relief.
- **The relief share** — the fraction of that late fee the relief returns: 10 percent, written 0.10.
- **The relief** — the late fee multiplied by the relief share, rounded to the cent with halves rounded up, and never more than the late fee itself.

## Calculation

1. The base is the amount of the late fee most recently booked on the line.
2. The base multiplied by the relief share of 0.10 gives the unrounded relief.
3. The unrounded relief rounded to the cent (half up) is the relief, never more than the late fee.

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fees)

| Late fee most recently booked | Multiplied by 0.10 | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| 2.50 | 0.25 | 0.25 |
| 1.88 | 0.188 | 0.19 |
| 1.25 | 0.125 | 0.13 (a half rounded up) |
| 0.50 | 0.05 | 0.05 |

A line whose activity shows a late fee of 1.40 booked on 3 May and a later late fee of 2.50 booked on 10 May takes 2.50 as its base, the later of the two: a relief of 0.25.
